newsitem.title: CHINA: Jan-Jun 97 fund sales hit record high in HK.
newsitem.headline: Jan-Jun 97 fund sales hit record high in HK.

text.p: Net sales of unit trusts in Hong Kong soared to a record high of US$1.36 billion in the first half of 1997, four times the equivalent period of 1996, the Hong Kong Investment Fund Association said on Tuesday.
Gross sales stood at US$4.15 billion, up 90 percent.
The association attributed the gain to Hong Kong equity funds, which drew gross sales of US$851.51 million.
Another important performer was the single Asian countries fund, excluding Hong Kong and Japan, which attracted gross sales of US$1.12 billion, it said in a statement.
The two categories accounted for 77.51 percent of the industry's net sales for the six month period.
"The strong performance of Hong Kong equity funds probably ties in with the overall strength of the local stock market," it said.
